covers: JSE session to mid-afternoon and the SARB rate decision, Thursday 19 November 2026
headline: SARB holds the repo rate at 7.25% on a 4–3 vote, with three members wanting a hike; Investec down 6.5% on results day
summary: The SARB left the repo rate unchanged at 7.25% on Thursday 19 November 2026, with four MPC members voting to hold and three for a 25bp hike; Governor Kganyago said the committee would "not hesitate to raise rates if needed" (BusinessTech, 19 Nov 2026). Just before the decision, at 14:49 SAST, the JSE All Share was at 106,342.8 and the rand at R17.22 per dollar, while Investec Ltd was down 6.5% after interim results (LRC Market Dashboard; Reuters via CNBC Africa, 19 Nov 2026). Wall Street opens at 16:30 SAST; Wednesday's close was mixed (S&P 500 -0.2%, Nasdaq +0.4%), and gold was at $3,736 this morning.

items.title: SARB holds repo rate at 7.25%; MPC split 4–3, with three votes for a hike
items.summary: The Reserve Bank kept the repo rate at 7.25% on 19 Nov 2026. Four members voted to hold and three for a 25bp increase. Kganyago said near-term inflation is above 5%, in line with this week's 5.2% CPI reading, and that high prints are expected to last into early next year before easing. He said the committee is pausing "for now" and "will not hesitate to raise rates if needed" to bring inflation back to the 3% target. The close vote keeps a further hike on the table at the next meeting.

items.title: Investec Ltd -6.5% and Investec plc -6.8% after interim results; ratings unchanged
items.summary: Investec reported headline earnings per share of 39.8 pence for the six months to 30 Sep 2026, up 8.4% from 36.7 pence, and declared an interim dividend of 18.5 pence, citing more client activity and a larger average loan book (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 19 Nov 2026). The shares fell anyway: Investec Ltd was at R124.75 (-6.5%) and Investec plc at R126.65 (-6.8%) at 10:33 SAST (LRC Stock Scanner), deeper than the -3.4% seen at 09:32. Both are rated HOLD by the LRC Stock Scanner (scores 67 and 62, valuation 'undervalued'); this note does not change either rating.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 19 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 19 Nov 2026 10:33 SAST

items.title: Pick n Pay +5.9% to R26.29; rating unchanged
items.summary: Pick n Pay traded at R26.29 at 10:33 SAST on 19 Nov 2026, up 5.9% on the day, having been up 7.1% at 09:32 (LRC Stock Scanner quotes). We have still not found a company announcement behind the move, so treat it as unexplained for now.
